title: Edge Platform & Deployment Engineer
description: Type: Full- timeExperience: 1 - 3 YearsLocation: MumbaiAbout The RoleYou own the stack that sits on the plant floor, and you grow it. Our edge gateway runs on a Linux box in a control panel. It talks to PLCs, CNCs and meters on one side and to our cloud on the other, and it has to keep doing that unattended for months. Every protocol we support is a separate installable app, and the list keeps growing: whenever a customer brings a controller we don't speak yet, you build the adapter for it.This is partly a product role. Most people who use what you build won't be engineers: plant operators, maintenance teams, our solutions and support staff, and partners setting up their own sites. You decide what gets built and how it works, so that someone who has never heard of a register map or a system unit can still configure a device, add tags, and know whether their data is healthy. If a feature only works when you're the one using it, it isn't finished.One morning you might be tracing a bad RS-485 cable on site. That afternoon you might be wrapping a vendor's C library for a new CNC, or redesigning a setup screen because a technician got stuck on it. You maintain the platform, extend it, shape it, and personally get it running on real devices at real sites.What You'll DoDecide what the platform should do next. Turn field problems, support tickets and customer requests into features, set priorities, and make the trade-offs between power, simplicity and reliability.Design for people unfamiliar with the tech:– Guided setup with defaults that work, plain-language errors, and validation that catches mistakes before they reach a device– Status and health that a non-engineer can read at a glance– Configuration that can't silently break something.Watch real users set up and run the product, find where they get stuck or need to call us, and remove those steps.Build new protocol apps to extend the ecosystem: take a protocol or controller we don't support yet, find the best library or vendor SDK for it, and ship a production adapter that follows our app contract (polling, packaging, install scripts, configurator, monitoring), so that every new protocol is just as easy to set up as the existing ones.Pick the right language for each job. Today the platform runs on Node.js, Python, C++, TypeScript and Bash, and the next adapter might need C#, Go, Java or Rust if that's where the only solid driver lives.Commission edge gateways at customer sites: install the device, configure the network, connect it to the PLCs, SCADA, DCS or meters, onboard it to the cloud, and confirm the data is right, not just that it's flowing.Read the existing OT setup before touching it: identify the assets, controllers, protocols, register and tag maps, network layout, and who owns what.Configure and troubleshoot the existing adapters (Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC UA, Siemens S7, Omron FINS, Mitsubishi MC, Fanuc FOCAS) and validate every value against the source.Maintain the core platform: the orchestrator and its web UI, the configurator, the install and uninstall scripts, and the data pipelines (Redpanda/Kafka, MQTT, HTTP).Own releases end to end: build, package, version, ship, and roll out to devices in the field without breaking any that are already live.Diagnose failures remotely and on site using logs, metrics, VPN, SSH and packet captures, then fix the root cause, not just the symptom.Keep deployments secure by default: segmented networks, least privilege, managed secrets, and read-only access to controllers unless writes are explicitly approved.Write the user guides, runbooks and site documentation that let others deploy and run the product without you.What We're Looking ForEngineering degree. Mandatory. Instrumentation, Electrical, Electronics, Computer Science, or equivalent.1 - 3 years in industrial automation, IIoT, OT integration, systems engineering, or a field-facing technical role.Product sense:– You think about who will use a feature before you think about how to build it– You can explain a technical constraint in plain language– You'll cut a clever option if it confuses the person on siteA generalist engineer, not a one-language developer:– You can pick up an unfamiliar codebase or language and be productive in it quickly– You choose tools by what the job needs (library maturity, vendor support, performance, how it deploys on an edge box), not by habit– You're comfortable reading C headers, vendor SDK docs and protocol specs to work out what a driver actually does.OT fundamentals you can apply on site:– PLCs, SCADA, DCS and historians: what each does and where data really lives– Industrial sensors, transmitters and energy meters– Digital and analog I/O: 4–20 mA, 0–10 V, scaling, dry and wet contacts– Serial wiring and RS-485 multidropHands-on with industrial protocols: Modbus TCP/RTU (function codes, register maps, byte order), OPC UA, and MQTT. Exposure to S7, FINS, MC, FOCAS, BACnet, EtherNet/IP, DNP3, IEC 61850 or IEC 60870-5-104 is a plus.Networking you can debug by hand: IP addressing and subnets, static vs DHCP, routing, VLANs, firewalls, VPNs, isolated or air-gapped plant networks, and Wireshark.Comfortable on Linux: the shell, systemd, journald, Nginx, permissions and sudo, package management, bash scripting.Basic IT/OT security principles: the Purdue model and network segmentation, IEC 62443 concepts, least privilege, secrets handling, and why you don't write to a running PLC without sign-off.Structured troubleshooting: you isolate the layer that's failing (wiring, device, protocol, network, service, cloud) instead of guessing.Clear written English. Your guides and site reports get read by people who weren't there, and often by people who aren't technical.Willing to travel to plants and work in panel rooms and on shop floors, roughly 30–40% of the time.Bonus PointsHas built a tool or internal product that non-technical people actually adopted, and iterated on it based on how they used it.Has written a protocol driver, or wrapped a vendor library, and run it against real hardware.Experience with Kafka/Redpanda, Prometheus/Grafana, React or TypeScript, CMake/vcpkg, or cross-compiling for ARM.CI/CD and packaging (Jenkins, offline installs for air-gapped sites).Comfortable using AI-assisted development to get up to speed on a new language or library quickly, and to close a gap while you're still on site.Has commissioned a system that actually went live and stayed live, or is an ex-automation, instrumentation or plant engineer who moved into software.Comfortable being told the panel is undocumented, the tag list is wrong and the network is flat, and getting it working anyway.Why Faclon?Industrial AI at real scale, across sectors and geographies. You own a platform that runs on real machines, not a demo. You decide which protocol it learns next and how easy it is for the next person to deploy. A small team where your judgment decides what ships, how it holds up in the field, and who can use it.

title: Sr. Backend Engineer - Python & FastAPI
description:
**Role Overview**

We are hiring a hands-on Senior Backend Engineer to design, build, deploy and operate the three interfaces through which clients access our factor library: a REST API, real-time WebSocket data streams, and an MCP server for AI applications.

You will own service architecture, library integration, real-time data delivery, authentication, client-specific access controls, licensing enforcement, rate limiting, documentation and production reliability. You will work closely with the factor-library team to turn its capabilities into secure, consistent and easy-to-use interfaces.

Python is the primary backend language and FastAPI the primary framework. This is an individual-contributor role with end-to-end ownership: you deploy, run and support what you build.

**Key Responsibilities**

**REST API Development**

* Build and maintain production REST APIs in Python using FastAPI.
* Define request and response schemas, input validation, error handling, HTTP semantics and interface versioning.
* Publish and maintain accurate OpenAPI specifications.
* Build a shared integration layer so the REST API, WebSocket streams and MCP server behave consistently.
* Maintain backward compatibility as the factor library and client interfaces evolve.

**Real-Time Data Streaming**

* Design and build WebSocket services in Python that stream factor values and related data to clients in real time.
* Manage connection lifecycle, subscriptions, heartbeats, reconnection and backpressure from slow consumers.
* Authenticate every WebSocket connection and enforce client entitlements on every subscription.
* Scale streaming fan-out across instances using Redis pub/sub or a message broker.

**MCP Server Development**

* Build an MCP server with the Python SDK that exposes factor-library capabilities to AI applications as tools and resources.
* Write precise tool descriptions and structured input and output schemas so AI clients invoke tools correctly.
* Implement remote connectivity and authentication, and test against compatible MCP clients.

**Concurrency and Computational Workloads**

* Use asyncio for I/O-bound work and keep event loops non-blocking under high concurrency.
* Run CPU-intensive factor computations in separate processes via multiprocessing or process pools.
* Run long or heavy jobs through distributed task queues such as Celery, RQ, Arq or Dramatiq, with timeouts, retries and resource limits.

**Security, Access Control and Rate Limiting**

* Implement authentication using OAuth 2.0, token validation and API keys, with secure secret management.
* Implement organisation-level authorisation and client-specific access controls so each client reaches only its licensed factors, datasets and features.
* Enforce licensing and entitlements consistently across REST endpoints, WebSocket subscriptions and MCP tools.
* Implement per-client rate limiting and usage quotas.
* Implement audit logging and protect sensitive information.

**Production Deployment and Operations**

* Containerise services with Docker and independently deploy them to production cloud and Linux environments.
* Own CI/CD pipelines, releases and rollback procedures.
* Implement health checks, structured logging, metrics, monitoring and alerting.
* Write automated pytest suites covering library integration, interface behaviour, streaming, permissions, rate limits and failure scenarios.
* Diagnose production incidents and improve reliability, latency and operating cost.
* Maintain runbooks and troubleshooting procedures.

**Developer Experience**

* Produce API documentation, WebSocket protocol documentation, MCP tool descriptions, integration guides and working examples.
* Document supported inputs, outputs, execution constraints and error conditions with the factor-library team.
* Support client onboarding and resolve integration issues.
* Provide Python client utilities or a lightweight SDK where they simplify adoption.

**Must-Have Requirements**

* 4+ years of hands-on experience building production REST APIs with Python and FastAPI.
* Hands-on experience implementing asynchronous programming, multiprocessing or distributed task queues for high-concurrency or CPU-intensive Python workloads.
* Independently deployed and maintained Dockerized Python backend services in a production cloud or Linux environment.
* Implemented authentication, authorisation, client-specific access controls and rate limiting for production APIs.
* Strong production Python: type hints, exception handling, dependency management and Pydantic-based validation.
* Automated testing with pytest, including integration tests, permission checks and failure handling.
* Observability in production: logs, metrics, alerts and incident diagnosis.
* Git, code review, CI/CD and controlled releases.
* Ownership of customer-facing APIs from design through deployment and ongoing operation, including supporting external developers.
* Clear written communication and the ability to explain technical trade-offs.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Built real-time data streaming services using WebSockets in Python.
  ﻿
* Built MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that expose custom Python tools or functions to AI applications.
* AI tool calling, structured outputs and permission-aware execution.
* PostgreSQL for client accounts, licensing configuration and service metadata.
* Redis, pub/sub and background workers.
* Building Python SDKs or other developer-facing libraries.
* Background in analytical software, financial technology or institutional platforms.

In this role, you will join Version 1 and partner with a leading US\-based financial technology and digital assets business, with opportunities to collaborate with US product, business and engineering teams from the client location in Mumbai.
   

  

 We are a values\-driven organisation. We hire people who share our values, recognise those who bring them to life and invest in their long\-term development. Invest in us, and we will invest in you.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Senior AI Backend Engineer**
**Build production AI for the future of financial markets.**
 Join Version 1 to build intelligent products for a leading US\-based financial technology and digital assets business operating across institutional trading, investment management and AI infrastructure.
   

  

 You will engineer the secure, scalable services behind production AI that supports high\-value decisions across trading, risk and portfolio management. Collaborating with an experienced US\-based engineering team, you will build Python APIs, real\-time data integrations and AI\-enabled backend services that solve genuine problems across financial markets. This is AI engineered for measurable business impact.
   

  

 Working with Financial Services, product and engineering stakeholders in the United States, you will translate business requirements into reliable software and connect applications to an established AI platform powered by Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore and SageMaker.
   

  

**Why this opportunity stands out**
* Build production AI services rather than isolated proofs of concept.
* Solve genuine challenges across trading, risk and portfolio management.
* Own backend services from design and data modelling through to production operation.
* Work with Python, AWS, LLMs, RAG, embeddings and real\-time data.
* Influence architecture, reliability and measurable business outcomes.
* Collaborate directly with senior US\-based product and engineering teams.


**What You Will Do**
* Design, build and maintain Python backend services and REST APIs that power Financial Services products.
* Design data models and work with relational and other data stores based on the needs of each product.
* Integrate backend services with an established AI platform using Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore and SageMaker\-based APIs.
* Build application features using LLMs, RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering and function calling.
* Apply distributed systems and software engineering principles to build secure, scalable and maintainable services.
* Write automated tests and maintain CI/CD pipelines for reliable, repeatable deployments.
* Diagnose and resolve production issues involving latency, reliability, performance and data quality.
* Implement observability across logs, metrics, tracing and alerts, with a focus on operational health and cost efficiency.
* Contribute across data pipelines, infrastructure and frontend touchpoints where needed to deliver features end to end.
* Partner with product, business, full\-stack, data and AI platform teams, and share backend and AI\-integration best practices.


**Qualifications**
 We are looking for an experienced backend engineer who combines strong Python and cloud engineering capability with commercial awareness and a genuine interest in Financial Services AI.
   

  

**Essential Experience**
* 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production\-grade backend services.
* Strong hands\-on Python experience and a solid understanding of software engineering and distributed systems fundamentals.
* Experience designing and developing secure, scalable REST APIs.
* Experience with relational database design, ideally PostgreSQL.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS or a comparable cloud platform, including building and operating production applications.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.
* Experience with observability, monitoring, reliability engineering, performance tuning and cost optimisation.
* Working knowledge of generative AI and LLM concepts, including RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering and function calling.
* Experience integrating applications with LLM or AI platform APIs such as Amazon Bedrock or an equivalent service.
* Experience implementing authentication, authorisation, SSO, RBAC and secrets management in production applications.
* Experience within Financial Services, fintech, capital markets, banking or another regulated environment.
* A genuine interest in trading, investment management, digital assets and cryptocurrency.
* Confidence communicating technical recommendations and trade\-offs to engineering and business stakeholders.


**Technology environment**
 Python \| REST APIs \| AWS \| Amazon Bedrock \| SageMaker \| AgentCore \| RAG \| Embeddings \| Kubernetes \| Terraform \| Docker \| PostgreSQL \| Databricks \| CI/CD \| Automated testing \| Observability \| OAuth2/OIDC \| SSO \| RBAC
   

  

 You do not need deep model\-training or agentic\-platform architecture experience. We value strong backend engineering fundamentals, practical AI integration experience and the judgement to build reliable products around an established AI platform.
   

  

**Valuable Additional Experience**
* Capital markets, trading, risk or portfolio management platforms.
* Digital assets, cryptocurrency, blockchain or tokenisation.
* Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, AgentCore or comparable AI services.
* Vector databases such as pgvector and AI\-powered search or retrieval.
* Databricks, Jenkins or real\-time data pipelines.
* Evaluating AI features for accuracy, latency, hallucination handling and graceful degradation.
* Awareness of regulatory and compliance considerations in Financial Services technology.
* Technical leadership or mentoring across engineering teams.


**Additional Information**
**Why Version 1?**
 At Version 1, you will deepen your expertise within our Financial Services practice while building sophisticated AI products for a global organisation operating across trading, investment management and digital assets.
   

  

* Quarterly performance\-related profit share, enabling employees to share in our success.
* Structured career progression, mentoring and regular development conversations through our Pathways programme.
* Flexible and hybrid working support, aligned with the needs of the role and client.
* Educational assistance and support for relevant professional certifications.
* Opportunities to develop expertise across AWS and other leading technologies.
* Employee recognition through our Annual Excellence Awards and Call\-Out platform.
* Health, wellbeing and financial support, alongside community and inclusion initiatives.


 Full details of the benefits available in India will be shared during the recruitment process.

 Version 1 is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences, including those shaped by disability and neurodiversity.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
**About Beacon Platform By CWAN**
 Beacon is a cloud\-native, cross\-asset risk analytics and quantitative development platform used by top\-tier asset managers and banks. It provides a transparent, extensible environment for building, deploying and scaling valuation models, pricing libraries and risk analytics across asset classes — including derivatives, structured products and fixed income. It combines pre\-built financial applications with a flexible developer infrastructure that lets quants and model developers write custom pricing and valuation logic, run scenario analysis, and integrate models directly into front\-office and risk workflows.
   

  

 The role
   

  

* You will own the reliability of Clearwater's risk and analytics applications in engineering terms — designing and building the automation, tooling and operational architecture that keeps the overnight and intraday pipelines correct and on time for asset managers and insurers who need to see their portfolios each morning.
* This is a senior engineering role on the application layer. The distinction that matters at this level: you are expected to retire classes of failure, not instances of them. When the same problem appears for the third time, we want the engineer who stops patching it and builds the thing that makes it impossible to fail. That work competes for time with the model and feature changes the quant and risk teams are asking for, so you will also need to argue for it in their terms — what the recurring failure is costing them now, and what fixing it properly buys them. Cloud fluency matters because the applications run on AWS and you need to operate them competently there, but you will not be provisioning the infrastructure beneath them.
* You will be based in Mumbai alongside the market data team — a group with front\-office training who partner on the genuinely hard analytics questions, not only on data plumbing. That adjacency is the point of the placement: you will sit with the quant, risk and market data teams and be expected to learn what the systems actually compute. When a curve build fails or an end\-of\-day risk run finishes late, we want engineers who can reason about which clients are affected and what the number means.
* The team is part of a globally distributed platform organisation spanning Mumbai, Tokyo and the US, with US\-based coverage for the London close, so every major market cutoff falls inside a staffed window. You will join and help shape a follow\-the\-sun on\-call rotation covering the end\-of\-day cycles of multiple regions. We are explicit about this because the three\-region model is what keeps it sustainable — there is no permanent night shift.
* You will have real ownership of the services you support and direct influence over how reliability is engineered into them. You will report to the support lead in Mumbai.


 What you'll do
   

  

 Design and build the tooling layer
   

  

* Own the diagnostic tooling strategy — including AI\-assisted tooling — so that establishing whether an issue is infrastructure or market data, and which clients it touches, takes seconds rather than a manual trawl through logs and jobs. Tooling, not documentation alone, is how we intend to get response times down.
* Write and review production\-quality Python that eliminates toil: runbook automation, health checks, self\-service diagnostics and remediation used across the team.
* Design automated recovery and self\-healing for analytics jobs, so a single failed task does not become a missed client deliverable.
* Set the observability standard — design monitoring and alerting around business outcomes (late valuations, missing risk measures, stale prices) rather than host and container metrics, and drive alert noise down so pages are actionable and rare.


 Own production and lead incidents
   

  

* Own incident response for client\-impacting issues: command the incident, mitigate, communicate, and run blameless postmortems that end in fixes rather than findings.
* Investigate at the application level — logs, stack traces, job histories and the code itself — to establish root cause, then fix it or hand the development team a diagnosis precise enough to act on.
* Track service commitments and recurring pain: report on timeliness and failure trends, and push through the fixes that retire repeat issues.
* Set the boundary for first\-line infrastructure work — stale hosts, memory pressure, connectivity failures, host loss — so routine cases are remediated locally and deeper platform work escalates cleanly.


 Harden the batch and end\-of\-day architecture
   

  

* Own and harden large\-scale batch and EOD processing: job orchestration, dependency management, retries, idempotency, backfills and safe reruns.
* Keep the overnight window on schedule — find where time is going across stages and drive the fixes with the development teams.


 Own the data and market data interface
   

  

* Support the reference data, market data and timeseries stores behind pricing and risk — schema and index design, replication, retention and query performance in NoSQL and timeseries systems.
* Operate data quality and reconciliation controls with the market data team: completeness checks, stale\-data and anomaly alerting, vendor feed failure handling.
* Debug data\-shaped production problems — a missing fixing, a bad identifier mapping, a holiday calendar difference, a failed download job, a partial vendor file — traced through to the affected downstream analytics.
* Act as a single escalation path with the market data team on front\-office\-facing issues, sharing triage and root cause rather than passing tickets between functions.


 Lead and influence
   

  

* Partner with quant developers and risk engineers to make reliability a design input rather than a post\-launch concern.
* Mentor engineers on incident triage, investigation technique and on\-call practice, and set the standards for automation and operational readiness.
* Contribute to production readiness reviews for new services and client onboardings.
* Support client escalations on risk and analytics output, and be the person client\-facing teams want in the room during an incident.
* Document architecture, runbooks and failure modes.


 What you'll bring
   

  

**Required**
* 7\+ years in software engineering for a business\-critical platform, with real ownership of services.
* Strong Python, plus shell. You must be comfortable reading and debugging application code to find root cause — this role is not runbook execution.
* Demonstrated troubleshooting depth — working from a vague client symptom through logs, job histories, data and code to a precise diagnosis.
* Hands\-on experience operating batch and scheduled workloads at scale, including workflow orchestration (Airflow, Prefect, Step Functions or equivalent).
* Solid grounding in distributed systems — you can reason about partial failure, retries, idempotency, consistency, and queue and backpressure behaviour under load.
* Working knowledge of AWS — enough to operate applications confidently (compute, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, basic networking) and to tell an infrastructure problem from an application one.
* Practical NoSQL experience (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra or similar): data modelling, indexing, replication and performance troubleshooting.
* Observability in practice — Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry or equivalent — and sensible alert design.
* On\-call experience with structured escalation and postmortem writing, and the judgement to lead an incident rather than only participate in one.
* A general understanding of financial systems and genuine appetite to learn the business. You should be able to hold a conversation about what a valuation or a risk number is for, and be willing to go deeper.
* Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work effectively in a globally distributed team.
* Degree (B.Tech / M.Tech / MCA / MSc) in computer science, engineering or a related field.


**Preferred**
* Experience with timeseries data at scale — storage and partitioning strategies, retention, and query patterns for large historical datasets.
* Experience supporting trading systems, order management systems, risk management systems or market data platforms.
* Familiarity with financial data concepts — instrument reference data, curves and fixings, corporate actions, EOD valuation cycles, VaR and sensitivities.
* Kubernetes and containerised workloads in production, from an operations perspective.
* Infrastructure as code and CI/CD — Terraform, Docker, GitHub Actions or GitLab CI — enough to make and review changes when the work calls for it.
* Streaming and event\-driven infrastructure (Kafka, Kinesis, MSK) and distributed compute (Spark, EMR, Dask, Ray).
* MongoDB Atlas, Redis / ElastiCache, or managed timeseries and analytical stores (Timestream, ClickHouse, Redshift).
* Working in a regulated financial environment — change management, access controls, audit evidence and client\-facing SLAs.
* Fluency with AI\-assisted development and operations tooling — using LLM\-based agents and assistants to build diagnostics, automate investigation and accelerate delivery.
* Experience mentoring engineers and setting operational standards across a team.


 What will make you stand out
   

  

* A track record of turning a fragile, hand\-held process into a stable service with measurably less manual intervention.
* Experience designing automated recovery, failover and monitoring specifically for analytics or compute\-heavy batch jobs.
* Tooling you built that measurably shortened time\-to\-diagnosis — and a view on where AI\-assisted tooling genuinely helps in an operations context and where it does not.
* The ability to translate a technical failure into client impact, and to be the person client\-facing teams want in the room during an incident.
* Curiosity about the domain: engineers who ask what the model is doing and why the number matters build far better reliability into these systems.

description:
**Position:** 
 C\+\+ Development (Senior Manager)
 



**Grade**

**Job Description / Roles \& Responsibilities** 




 The Technical Lead C\+\+ Development (Senior Manager) will act as the core technical authority and delivery anchor for our ultra\-low\-latency engineering pod. This role balances hands\-on, high\-performance C\+\+ systems programming (roughly 60%\-70% of the time) with technical mentorship and agile sprint management (30–40%). The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between high\-level architectural designs and concrete, microsecond\-optimized code implementation.
 



 Core Role Information
 


* Designation: Technical Lead (Senior Manager) – C\+\+ Development
* Department: Technology
* Reporting To: Assistant Vice President (AVP) – Development Head



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Hands\-on Low\-Latency Systems Engineering** 



* Write, optimize, and maintain high\-performance execution engines and market data applications using Modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17/20\).
* Implement deterministic, low\-latency programming paradigms, strictly avoiding runtime heap allocations (malloc/new) on the trading hot\-path through custom memory pools and placement new.
* Develop ultra\-fast Inter\-Process Communication (IPC) frameworks—such as shared memory rings and lock\-free circular queues—to pass data across trading components with sub\-microsecond overhead.
* Design highly concurrent, multi\-threaded workflows, configuring thread affinity (pthread\_setaffinity\_np) and optimizing data layouts to prevent CPU cache thrashing and lock contention.
* Incorporate proprietary template\-based architectures or High\-Level Template (HTL) constructs to shift computational logic to compile\-time.



**2\. Core Data Engineering \& Domain Integration** 



* Apply expert\-level knowledge of Data Structures and Algorithms to engineer optimal custom indexing, sorting, and binary parsing solutions.
* Design and maintain high\-throughput relational tracking databases using MySQL for order logs, risk configurations, and reference data management.
* Leverage trading domain knowledge to translate complex financial logic (such as order routing, compliance checks, risk management parameters, or exchange protocols like FIX, ITCH, or SBE) into concrete technical implementations.



**3\. Technical Leadership \& Code Governance** 



* Lead daily sprint cycles, translate functional specifications into technical tasks, and ensure timely product delivery.
* Enforce absolute code quality via strict peer code reviews, continuous profiling (using tools like Valgrind, gprof, or Perf), and performance regression benchmarking.
* Provide daily technical guidance and mentorship to engineers, establishing standardized coding guidelines for the team.



  





**Job Specific Skills** 



* C\+\+ \& Metaprogramming Expertise: Exceptional mastery of systems\-level C\+\+, including template metaprogramming, RAII, smart pointers, and strict memory safety.
* Concurrency Mastery: Practical experience writing production\-grade, lock\-free, atomic, and multi\-threaded processing pipelines.
* Low\-Latency Infrastructure: Clear understanding of CPU architectures (cache line synchronization, branch predictors) and Linux OS tuning (core isolation, kernel bypass).
* Data Layout \& DB Optimization: Advanced ability to optimize algorithms for hardware cache locality and structure complex database queries, indexes, and schemas in MySQL.
* HTL Frameworks: Experience using template libraries or customized HTL concepts to achieve zero\-overhead abstractions.



  





**Minimum Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related quantitative stream.
* Experience: 8\+ years of professional software development experience in systems programming, with at least 3\+ years of experience leading small\-to\-mid\-sized developer teams or pods.
* Domain Advantage: Prior background in High\-Frequency Trading (HFT), investment bank execution desks, derivatives risk systems, or market data feeds is highly desirable.



  





 For more details, contact Archana at Archana.tiwari@tnmhr.com / \+91 9821821884\.

**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
 Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best\-in\-class solutions.
   

  

**About BNP Paribas Group**
 BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialised businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial \& personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast\-growing business in Asia\-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability
   

  

 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
   

  

 At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in.
   

  

**About Business Line/Function**
 The Global Markets business of BNP Paribas helps its corporate and institutional clients leverage capital markets across the globe for their financing, risk management and investment needs. This encompasses a wide range of financial products ranging from Foreign exchange to complex Equity Derivatives that are traded in financial markets across the globe 24/7\. IT systems are integral to the business and are a key part of the value proposition to clients. These IT systems range from industry standard products for standard process automation to internally developed, often, market leading IT applications. The IT teams owning these IT systems are made up of functions that include Technical and Application production support, Business Analysis \& Project Management, Development \& Maintenance and Quality Control. BNP Paribas India Solutions is an equal partner in these IT functions along with colleagues in other locations including Paris, London, New York, Tokyo, Singapore \& Hong Kong. title: Security Researcher
description:
**About Job:** 




 We are looking for a security researcher with strong software engineering skills to help build an AI product for vulnerability discovery and validation. You will turn offensive security knowledge into agent capabilities, tools, and backend workflows that investigate customer and open source systems reliably.
 



  





**What you will build:** 



* Build backend components for agent execution, tool calling, model integration, and structured findings.
* Translate vulnerability research into agent workflows, reusable tools, and source code analysis capabilities.
* Implement controlled tool execution, sandbox isolation, scoped permissions, resource limits, and cleanup.
* Build persistent run state, retries, cancellation, crash recovery, and event streaming.
* Integrate security tools, independent verification, and evidence capture so findings are reproducible.
* Create realistic security scenarios, PoC\-based checks, and regression tests to improve detection quality and reduce false positives.



  





**Engineering experience:** 



* 3\+ years in software engineering, security engineering, or security research, with a track record of building software or security tools.
* Strong TypeScript/Node.js skills and Python experience for tooling, automation, and integrations.
* Experience with APIs, asynchronous systems, databases, automated testing, and debugging complex failures.
* Comfort with Linux, Docker, process/network behavior, and LLM tool calling; clear communication and ownership of components through delivery.



  





**Security knowledge** 



* Bring broad awareness across these layers, with hands\-on depth in at least two areas. Web/API or source code security should be one of your strongest areas.
* Web and APIs: injection, XSS, SSRF, IDOR/BOLA, authorization, tenant isolation, and business\-logic abuse.
* Source code and dependencies: insecure deserialization, memory safety fundamentals, vulnerable libraries, malicious packages, and CVE reproduction.
* AI and LLMs: prompt injection, jailbreaks, unsafe tool use, and MCP trust boundaries.
* Identity and infrastructure: network security, Active Directory, cloud IAM, federation, and privilege escalation.
* Runtime and systems: container, sandbox, and VM isolation; operating\-system permissions, service/library flaws, and kernel attack surfaces.
* Deep kernel research, exploit development, fuzzing, or agent\-framework experience is a plus.



  





**Show us what you have built** 




 Share backend or agent systems, security tools, or open source contributions you have built. Explain what you owned, the security reasoning, design choices, and reliability challenges. CVEs, bug bounties, and research write\-ups provide additional context. A high\-level description is welcome for confidential work.

 Build Reliable Backend Systems at Scale

 You’ll work across Node.js, REST APIs, databases, distributed systems, asynchronous workflows, security, testing, and production reliability—solving real engineering problems rather than simply building individual APIs.

 Node.js \& Backend Development

 AWS, Azure, or GCP.

title: AVP Backend Engineering
description:
**ABOUT BELLEVIE** 




 BelleVie is a Lodha Group\-backed premium lifestyle technology platform for gated communities — bringing together everything a home or office needs, from community operations and resident experiences to a curated ecosystem of premium brands and services.
 



  





 Our vision is to enable people to
 **“Live the Beautiful Life”** 
 by creating seamless, trusted and technology\-led experiences across everyday community living.
 



  





 As BelleVie continues to scale, our technology platform is becoming critical digital infrastructure for the communities we serve. We are looking for an experienced
 **AVP Engineering (Backend)** 
 to lead the architecture, scalability, reliability, engineering execution and people behind this platform.
 



  





**THE ROLE** 




 This is a senior engineering leadership role with end\-to\-end ownership of BelleVie’s backend engineering ecosystem.
 



  





 You will lead the backend engineering team and own the platform across
 **system architecture, services, data, APIs, scalability, reliability, engineering quality, technology operations and people development** 
 .
 



  





 We are looking for more than a people manager. You should be a strong technology leader who has personally built and scaled complex consumer technology platforms, understands systems deeply, can challenge architectural decisions, and remains close enough to engineering and code to have a well\-informed technical point of view.
 



  





 You will work closely with Product, Mobile, QA, DevOps, Data and business leadership to ensure technology choices translate into better customer experiences, faster execution, higher reliability and sustainable scale.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WILL OWN** 




**System Design \& Architecture** 




 • Own and evolve the backend architecture across microservices, APIs, data and integrations
 



 • Define the target architecture and technology roadmap for the next phase of scale
 



 • Establish clear service boundaries and scalable system design principles
 



 • Drive architecture reviews and maintain high engineering standards
 



 • Design secure, scalable and highly optimised RESTful services
 



 • Continuously simplify architecture and systematically address technical debt
 



 • Evaluate technology choices based on scalability, reliability, maintainability, performance and business needs
 



  





**Scalability, Reliability \& Performance** 




 • Architect for scalability, high availability, fault tolerance and performance
 



 • Establish capacity planning, load testing and proactive performance management
 



 • Build strong observability across application and infrastructure layers
 



 • Strengthen monitoring, alerting and incident detection
 



 • Identify performance bottlenecks and drive optimisation to root cause
 



 • Reduce incident frequency and blast radius through better architecture and engineering practices
 



 • Treat infrastructure utilisation and cost efficiency as engineering metrics
 



  





**Engineering \& Delivery Excellence** 




 • Own engineering execution from design through production
 



 • Translate product and business requirements into robust technical plans
 



 • Establish architecture, coding, review and engineering standards
 



 • Ensure meaningful code reviews focused on scalability, maintainability, security and performance
 



 • Improve development velocity without compromising engineering quality
 



 • Drive predictable releases and continuously improve the software delivery lifecycle
 



 • Stay hands\-on enough to review critical designs, troubleshoot complex problems and contribute technically when required
 



  





**End\-to\-End Technology Operations** 




 • Own the complete lifecycle — design, build, test, release, monitor and support
 



 • Establish strong release, incident, problem and change management practices
 



 • Define meaningful SLAs/SLOs for business\-critical services
 



 • Strengthen production monitoring, on\-call practices and incident response
 



 • Drive root\-cause analysis and ensure corrective actions translate into permanent improvements
 



 • Embed security, privacy and data protection into engineering and architecture by design
 



  





**Team \& Leadership** 




 • Lead, mentor and inspire a high\-performing backend engineering team
 



 • Identify and develop technical leads and module owners with clear accountability
 



 • Grow senior engineers into independent technical and people leaders
 



 • Establish clear engineering KPIs and performance expectations
 



 • Coach engineers through architecture reviews, technical feedback and structured development plans
 



 • Attract, hire and retain exceptional engineering talent
 



 • Build succession and reduce dependency on individual engineers
 



 • Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, innovation, collaboration and continuous improvement
 



  





**TECHNOLOGY LANDSCAPE** 




 Backend: Node.js, REST APIs, Microservices
 



 Databases: MongoDB / MongoDB Atlas, relational databases and SQL
 



 Search: ElasticSearch / Solr
 



 Cloud: AWS
 



 Containers: Docker, Kubernetes
 



 Caching \& Async Processing: Redis, BullMQ, Kafka, RabbitMQ or equivalent
 



 DevOps: CI/CD, Jenkins, SonarQube, Spinnaker or equivalent
 



 Engineering: Distributed Systems, System Design, Data Structures \& Algorithms, Observability, Performance Optimisation and Debugging
 



 Experience with payment gateways and large\-scale mobile application backends would be valuable.
 



  





**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR** 




 • 8\+ years of backend engineering experience, including engineering leadership experience
 



 • Proven experience designing and scaling high\-performance, highly available and fault\-tolerant consumer platforms
 



 • Strong expertise in system design, distributed systems and microservice architecture
 



 • Strong understanding of Data Structures \& Algorithms
 



 • Deep hands\-on experience with Node.js and scalable API development
 



 • Strong experience with MongoDB / MongoDB Atlas and database/query optimisation
 



 • Strong understanding of AWS and cloud\-native architecture
 



 • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, caching, queues and asynchronous processing
 



 • Experience running production technology operations end to end
 



 • Strong debugging, analytical and performance optimisation capabilities
 



 • Proven ability to mentor engineers and develop technical leaders
 



 • Strong communication and stakeholder\-management capabilities
 



 • Customer\-centric mindset with strong ownership and bias for execution
 



  





 A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline is preferred, though we place greater emphasis on
 **what you have built, scaled and led** 
 .
 



  





**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** 




 In your first few months, we expect you to develop a deep understanding of BelleVie’s architecture, engineering organisation and production ecosystem; establish clear technology and performance baselines; define the target architecture and engineering standards; strengthen ownership across the team; and begin delivering measurable improvements across scalability, reliability, observability, engineering quality and execution.
 



  





 Over time, success means building a platform that can scale significantly beyond today’s requirements — and an engineering organisation capable of operating that platform without depending on any single individual.
 



  





**THE OPPORTUNITY** 




 This is an opportunity to take ownership of a live, high\-scale consumer technology platform at an important stage of its growth journey.
 



  





 The mandate goes beyond managing engineering delivery. You will shape the architecture for BelleVie’s next phase, influence technology strategy, solve complex scale and reliability challenges, build engineering leadership depth and create systems that millions of interactions can depend on.
 



  





**We are looking for someone who can show us what they have built and scaled — not just what they have managed.**

title: Solutions Architect - IIOT
description:
About the Role
 
  





 We are looking for an experienced IoT Solutions Architect with strong hands\-on background in Industrial IoT (IIoT) to design, architect, and lead end\-to\-end implementation of IoT solutions across manufacturing, energy, utilities, or other industrial environments. This role requires someone who has not just designed architectures on paper but has actually built, deployed, and supported IIoT solutions in real production/plant environments.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities
 
  





 •       Design end\-to\-end IoT/IIoT architecture — from edge devices, sensors, and gateways to cloud platforms, data pipelines, and analytics/visualization layers.
 



 •       Lead technical implementation of IIoT projects including device connectivity (OPC\-UA, Modbus, MQTT, PROFINET, LoRaWAN), edge computing, and integration with SCADA/PLC/DCS/MES systems.
 



 •       Define data ingestion, storage, and processing architecture (time\-series DBs, stream processing, digital twin frameworks).
 



 •       Select and integrate appropriate IoT platforms (AWS IoT, Azure IoT Hub, GCP IoT, PTC ThingWorx, Siemens MindSphere, etc.) based on client/business needs.
 



 •       Own solution architecture from PoC to production rollout, including scalability, security, and reliability considerations.
 



 •       Collaborate with OT/IT teams to bridge industrial systems with enterprise IT and cloud infrastructure.
 



 •       Define and implement IoT security architecture — device authentication, data encryption, network segmentation (IT/OT security).
 



 •       Create technical documentation: architecture diagrams, solution blueprints, deployment guides, and SOPs.
 



 •       Work closely with sales/pre\-sales teams for solutioning, technical proposals, and client presentations.
 



 •       Design and deploy LoRaWAN\-based sensor networks, including gateway placement, network server configuration, and device provisioning.
 



 •       Troubleshoot and resolve architecture\-level issues during deployment and post\-production support.
 



  




 Required Skills \& Experience
 
  





 •       4–5 years in IoT/embedded systems/industrial automation, with hands\-on experience in IIoT solution architecture and implementation.
 



 •       Proven experience implementing (not just designing) IIoT solutions — device onboarding, edge deployment, cloud integration, dashboarding.
 



 •       Strong knowledge of industrial protocols: OPC\-UA, Modbus, MQTT, PROFINET, BACnet, etc.
 



 •       Hands\-on experience with LoRaWAN technologies — network architecture, gateway/end\-node deployment, network server platforms (e.g., The Things Stack, ChirpStack), and LoRaWAN device integration.
 



 •       Hands\-on experience with one or more IoT/cloud platforms: AWS IoT Core/Greengrass, Azure IoT Hub/Edge, GCP Cloud IoT, PTC ThingWorx, Siemens MindSphere, Litmus, or similar.
 



 •       Experience with edge computing devices/gateways (e.g., Dell Edge Gateways, Advantech, Siemens IoT2050, Raspberry Pi/industrial variants).
 



 •       Understanding of SCADA, PLC, DCS, MES, and OT network architecture.
 



 •       Experience with time\-series databases (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB) and data visualization tools (Grafana, Power BI).
 



 •       Knowledge of containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) for edge/cloud deployments.
 



 •       Familiarity with IoT security best practices (device identity, PKI, network segmentation).
 



 •       Strong scripting/programming skills (Python, Node.js, or similar) for automation and integration work.
 



 •       Experience working directly at customer/plant sites for deployment, commissioning, and troubleshooting is a strong plus.
 



  




 Preferred Qualifications
 
 •       Certifications such as AWS/Azure IoT specialty, CSSA, or relevant OT security certifications.
 



 •       Experience with digital twin implementations.
 



 •       Exposure to predictive maintenance / condition monitoring use cases.
 



 •       Prior experience in manufacturing, energy, utilities, or process industries.
 



  




 Education
 * •       B.E./B.Tech in Electronics, Computer Science, Instrumentation, or related field (M.Tech/MS preferred but not mandatory).

title: Process Engineer - AI Automation & Business Process Management
description:
**At a Glance: The Story Behind AMINA** 




  





 Founded in April 2018 and headquartered in Zug, AMINA Bank is a pioneer in the financial industry. In August 2019, AMINA received a Swiss banking and securities dealer license from FINMA. The broad, vertically integrated spectrum of services, combined with the highest security standards, make AMINA’s value proposition unique.
 



 AMINA operates globally from its regulated hubs in Switzerland, Abu Dhabi, and Hong Kong to offer fiat and crypto services to progressive investors, traditional and crypto\-native alike, whether individuals, corporates, or institutions.
 



  





 CVVC Global Report and CB Insights named AMINA as one of the Top 50 Companies within the blockchain ecosystem. Aite Group awarded AMINA their 2021 Digital Wealth Management Impact Innovation Award in the ‘Digital Startup of the Year’ category, and LinkedIn listed AMINA as one of the Top Startups 2021 in Switzerland. In 2022, AMINA won the Digital Assets Offering or Service at the WealthBriefing Swiss EAM Awards, and the bank was also recognized for its product offering SEBAX and won the Best ETP of the Year award at the Swiss ETF Awards 2022\. In 2023, AMINA won the European WealthBriefing Award in the Digital Assets Solution, Fund Manager category.
 



  





 AMINA India is a wholly owned subsidiary of AMINA Bank AG. AMINA India acts as a virtual extension of the bank supporting activities spanning trading \& liquidity management, digital assets research, marketing, investment solutions, risk management, account management, mid/back\-office, product management, technology \& engineering, IT support, finance and human resources.
 



  





**Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It)** 




  





 At AMINA India, we are looking for an experienced professional to lead end‑to‑end process discovery, redesign, and AI\-driven automation across critical business functions, ensuring efficiency, scalability, and measurable impact. The role also champions compliant, well\-governed solutions while driving adoption through close collaboration with stakeholders, delivering sustainable, high\-value transformation.
 



  





**Your AMINA To\-Do List** 




  





**Discover, map and redesign processes** 



* Run process\-discovery workshops with teams across compliance, onboarding, operations, treasury, and client services.
* Produce clear, accurate process maps (BPMN or equivalent) and document the inputs, decisions, controls, and hand\-offs in each workflow.
* Redesign and optimize the process at hand, preparing it for potential automation / AI integration
* Identify automation candidates and quantify the opportunity — FTE saved, cycle\-time reduction, error\-rate impact, and cost.



**Design and build AI\-driven automation** 



* Translate process pain points into automation solutions using LLM\-based workflows, integration platforms, and APIs.
* Build, test, and iterate on automations — from document extraction and drafting assistants to alert triage, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Engineer reliable prompts and pipelines, design the human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and evaluate AI output quality with real test sets rather than vibes.
* Track token usage, run\-cost, and ROI per initiative, and make pragmatic build\-vs\-buy and model\-selection decisions.



**Keep it compliant and governed** 



* Design every automation so the accountable human still owns the decision — especially in regulated processes (KYC/AML, transaction monitoring, reporting).
* Work with Compliance, Risk, and IT to ensure solutions meet control, audit, data\-protection, and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain documentation, change logs, and a clear inventory of what's automated, who owns it, and how it's monitored.



**Drive adoption** 



* Partner with business owners to pilot, refine, and roll out automations — and to get genuine buy\-in, not shelfware.
* Build internal momentum for AI adoption in a risk\-aware environment, navigating IT and security gatekeeping constructively.
* Train users, write SOPs, and hand over solutions in a maintainable state.



  





**Your golden ticket to the AMINA team:** 




  




* 4–10 years of experience in Business Process Management, Process Improvement, Automation, or Operational Transformation.
* Proven experience analyzing, redesigning, and optimizing business processes using structured methodologies (e.g., BPMN, Lean, Six Sigma, Process Mining).
* Strong stakeholder management and requirements\-gathering skills across business and technical teams.
* Hands\-on experience with AI and workflow automation tools, including LLMs, APIs, and integration platforms (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier).
* Practical understanding of prompt engineering, AI evaluation, and implementation of appropriate controls and guardrails.
* Working knowledge of Python or similar scripting languages and data analysis.
* Experience within banking, fintech, financial services, or another regulated industry.
* Understanding of financial\-services processes such as KYC, AML, onboarding, payments, reconciliation, or regulatory reporting.
* Knowledge of risk, controls, audit requirements, and regulatory compliance considerations.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to bridge business, compliance, and technology stakeholders.
* Self\-starter with a pragmatic, delivery\-focused approach and the ability to thrive in ambiguous environments.



 Preferred
 


* Experience with crypto, digital assets, or blockchain\-related processes.
* Familiarity with FINMA, MiCA, AML, or similar regulatory frameworks.
* Experience with RAG, AI assistants, agentic workflows, Process Mining, or RPA tools. German language skills are a plus.



  





**Why We’re Awesome** 




  





 We owe our exponential growth to our innovative and collaborate team spirit and talented workforce. Every voice counts as we are always committed to learning from diverse perspectives and backgrounds because our people make the difference at AMINA Bank.
 **Regardless of your age, gender, belief, and background, at AMINA EVERYONE is welcome!** 




  





 Join our skilled team and together redefine finance.

title: GDS Cyber-DPP-Manager-AI Data Protection Engineering
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AI Data Protection Forward Deployed Engineer – Manager**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI Data Protection Forward Deployed Engineer – Manager to act as the technical owner for client\-facing data protection transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a hands\-on leader who can move from discovery to design to deployment, embedding closely with clients to architect and implement high\-impact solutions while leading engineering teams and shaping deals. Your internal role matrix positions this level as the next step beyond field/staff engineering: not just delivery, but architecting solutions at the intersection of platforms and AI tools (agents and models). That aligns closely with external FDE market patterns focused on customer\-embedded technical ownership and end\-to\-end production deployment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the discovery, architecture, and deployment of AI\-enabled data protection solutions for strategic clients, translating business, privacy, and cybersecurity requirements into scalable technical designs.
* Serve as a forward deployed technical leader, embedding with client stakeholders to break down ambiguous problem statements, make architecture decisions, and drive measurable outcomes in production. External FDE role definitions from EY, Databricks, Palantir, and Deloitte all emphasize this embedded technical ownership model.
* Architect integrations across data protection platforms, AI models, copilots, RAG pipelines, enterprise data estates, and downstream security/policy controls.
* Lead engineering teams through build, integration, testing, troubleshooting, go\-live, and post\-deployment hardening while maintaining delivery quality, client confidence, and practical execution pace.
* Shape pursuit solutions through demonstrations, solution architecture, proofs of concept, effort estimates, and technical proposals. This is explicitly called out in external FDE manager patterns.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI data protection offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 8–12 years of experience across data protection, cybersecurity engineering, security architecture, privacy engineering, cloud security, or related fields.
* Strong depth in data protection, data discovery/classification, PKI \& KMS, and information rights management.
* Strong working knowledge of ML, deep learning, NLP, RAG, AI\-assisted prioritization, and model risk scoring, with experience applying these to enterprise problem\-solving.
* Demonstrated experience designing and deploying enterprise\-grade solutions across cloud and hybrid environments, ideally on Azure, AWS, or GCP. Comparable FDE manager roles consistently require cloud\-native delivery, APIs, and production systems ownership.
* Hands\-on experience with AI/data protection tooling such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Claude Enterprise, Gemini Enterprise, Purview, DSPM platforms, Python, and related enterprise engineering tools.
* Strong client\-facing communication and the ability to operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in a professional services, solutions engineering, field engineering, or forward deployed model.
* Familiarity with regulated sectors such as financial services, healthcare, public sector, or large multinational enterprises. External senior digital trust/privacy FDE roles explicitly value regulated\-industry depth.
* Experience with pricing inputs, solution estimation, and technical deal shaping.


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect sensitive data in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of data protection, privacy, cloud, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the data protection practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.
   

  

**Typical work environment**
* Global, cross\-functional teams
* Mix of advisory, architecture, engineering, and delivery
* Exposure to strategic client programs and market\-shaping offerings
* Opportunity to build reusable assets, accelerators, and modernization patterns consistent with a global delivery model


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
